text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-san.
Thank you for giving me some time off.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, look here. We were running low on nukazuke,
so I was able to pickle a fresh batch.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I even got to take care of my rice bran bed that I'd been meaning to tend to.
What a wonderful day off~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Have you eaten breakfast, Trainer-san?
If not, I'll give you some crunchy snacks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Wonder Acute had taken advantage of her day off to prepare her favorite treat.
